key_insight: MRI radiomics shows moderate ability to predict KRAS mutation status in rectal cancer from preoperative scans.
clinical_relevance: This noninvasive approach may help support pre-treatment molecular stratification, but it is not yet ready to replace tissue-based testing.
method: Systematic review and meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy studies.
Included 7 studies with 1,224 rectal cancer patients.
Compared MRI radiomics/AI predictions against molecular KRAS testing using a bivariate random-effects model.
evidence_signal: Pooled performance was moderate, with sensitivity 0.736, specificity 0.645, and hierarchical summary AUC 0.754.
watch_item: Evidence is still limited by small study numbers and variable heterogeneity, so external validation is needed before clinical implementation.
paper_title: Diagnostic Accuracy of MRI Radiomics for Predicting KRAS Mutation in Rectal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
